description: Synthetic rough interview notes for question extraction.

input.notes: Mostly behavioural. Asked about influence without authority, prioritisation and a time I changed my mind. I used the roadmap reset, the cost work and the migration. The interviewer asked follow-ups on the metrics for each. I forgot to mention the customer name on the last answer. One interviewer pushed on the difference between influencing a decision and owning it. I used the roadmap reset to show where I owned the cut and where I only recommended the sequence. The other interviewer asked how I handled the customer who disagreed; I described the two options I offered and the evidence I used to settle the choice. They also asked how I measure whether a weekly review is working. I said I look at whether decisions are written down, whether the same blocker returns and whether the team lead can run the review without me. I gave the example of the new lead who took over the agenda after six weeks. I forgot to mention the shared checklist until the follow-up.
